quests.name: Daily Delivery
quests.text: Deliver the Bundle of Crocolisk Skins to James Halloran, the tanner, in Menethil Harbor.

quests.name: A Lack of Virtue
quests.text: Deliver Tom's Gift to Bart Tidewater in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

quests.name: Unrequited Love
quests.text: Deliver Hollee's Note to Tarrel Rockweaver near Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

quests.name: The Algaz Gauntlet
quests.text: Traverse Dun Algaz.  Kill 8 Dragonmaw Scouts and 6 Dragonmaw Grunts.  Report to Valstag Ironjaw in Menethil Harbor.

quests.name: Report to Mountaineer Rockgar
quests.text: Speak with Mountaineer Rockgar.

quests.name: Tramping Paws
quests.text: Kill 15 Mosshide Gnolls and 10 Mosshide Mongrels, then return to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands.

quests.name: The Greenwarden
quests.text: Find the Greenwarden.

quests.name: Young Crocolisk Skins
quests.text: Obtain 4 Young Crocolisk Skins for James Halloran in Menethil Harbor.

quests.name: Spoils of War
quests.text: Recover 6 Khaz Modan Timber and 30 Khaz Modan Iron from Menethil Harbor for Valstag Ironjaw.

quests.name: Claws from the Deep
quests.text: Kill 12 Bluegill Murlocs.  Slay Gobbler and take his head.  Bring Gobbler's Head to Karl Boran in Menethil Harbor.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.text: Fill the Empty Brown Waterskin at the bottom of the waterfalls below Hervdana's cave and return it to her in the Wetlands.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.text: Fill the Empty Red Waterskin at Stonewatch Falls near the Nightcrawler Murlocs and return to Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.

quests.name: Alchemical Hazards
quests.text: Collect an Unruptured Stalker Gland from Thelgen Rock for Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.

quests.name: Fire Taboo
quests.text: Bring Rethiel the Greenwarden 9 Crude Flints.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.text: Fill the Unfilled Blue Waterskin at the waters of Astranaar in Ashenvale and return to Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.text: Bring the Vial of Purest Water to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.

quests.name: Digging Through the Ooze
quests.text: One of the oozes at Ironbeard's Tomb has Sida's bag, retrieve it and bring it back to her in Menethil Harbor.

quests.name: In Search of The Excavation Team
quests.text: Tarrel Rockweaver wants you to travel to the Excavation Site and contact Merrin Rockweaver.

quests.name: In Search of The Excavation Team
quests.text: Return to Tarrel Rockweaver with Merrin's note.

quests.name: Ormer's Revenge
quests.text: Ormer Ironbraid at the Whelgar Excavation Site wants you to kill 10 Mottled Screechers and 10 Mottled Raptors.

quests.name: Reclaiming Goods
quests.text: Search the crates and barrels at the coastal Murloc camps.

quests.name: The Search Continues
quests.text: Search for the Menethil Statuette.

quests.name: Search More Hovels
quests.text: Continue searching the Murloc hovels for the Menethil Statuette.

quests.name: Return the Statuette
quests.text: Bring Karl Boran the Menethil Statuette.

quests.name: Return the Statuette
quests.text: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep.

quests.name: Fall of Dun Modr
quests.text: Search for Longbraid near the town of Dun Modr.

quests.name: Apprentice's Duties
quests.text: Collect 6 Giant Crocolisk Skins and bring them to James Halloran in Menethil Harbor.

quests.name: Blisters on The Land
quests.text: Kill 12 Fen Creepers, then return to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands.

quests.name: Crocs of the Sky
quests.text: Collect 8 Pristine Crimson Scales and bring them to James Halloran in Menethil Harbor.

quests.name: The Third Fleet
quests.text: Buy First Mate Fitzsimmons a Flagon of Mead.

quests.name: Ormer's Revenge
quests.text: Ormer Ironbraid wants you to kill 10 Mottled Scytheclaw raptors and 10 Mottled Razormaw raptors then return to him at the Whelgar Excavation Site.

quests.name: Uncovering the Past
quests.text: Prospector Whelgar wants you to scour the excavation site in search of the 4 missing tablet fragments: Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru.

quests.name: War Banners
quests.text: Bring 8 Dragonmaw War Banners to Captain Stoutfist.

quests.name: Report to Captain Stoutfist
quests.text: Speak with Captain Stoutfist.

quests.name: From the Ashes
quests.text: Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep wants you to destroy the 4 sets of Attack Plans in the Angerfang Encampment.

quests.name: Bloom of the Heavens
quests.text: Recover Nord'el for Sylessa Duskwhisper in Menethil Harbor.

quests.name: Crimson Crate Delivery
quests.text: Bring the Crimson Crate to Howin Kindfeather off the road to the east of Menethil Harbor.

quests.name: Razormaw Needling
quests.text: Collect 10 Razormaw Incisors for Howin Kindfeather.

quests.name: Trying Times
quests.text: Gather 12 Perfect Razormaw Eggs for Howin Kindfeather.

quests.name: The Cursed Crew
quests.text: Kill 13 Cursed Sailors, 5 Cursed Marines and First Mate Snellig. Bring Snellig's Snuffbox to First Mate Fitzsimmons in Menethil Harbor.

quests.name: Ormer's Revenge
quests.text: Ormer Ironbraid at the Whelgar Excavation Site wants you to kill Sarltooth and return to him with one of his talons once the task is fulfilled.

quests.name: Bloom of the Heavens
quests.text: Bring Nord'el to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine in Darkshore.  You recall Sylessa mentioning a boat in Menethil Harbor can take you there.

quests.name: This Land Was Their Land
quests.text: Find Howin Kindfeather east of Menethil Harbor, along the road.

quests.name: Lifting the Curse
quests.text: Get the Intrepid Strongbox Key from Captain Halyndor.  Use the key to open the Intrepid's Locked Strongbox.

quests.name: The Eye of Paleth
quests.text: Bring the Cursed Eye of Paleth to Glorin Steelbrow.

quests.name: Cleansing the Eye
quests.text: Bring Archbishop Benedictus the Cursed Eye of Paleth. Benedictus is in the Cathedral of Light, in the city of Stormwind.

quests.name: The Dark Iron War
quests.text: Motley Garmason at Dun Modr wants you to kill 10 Dark Iron Dwarves, 5 Dark Iron Tunnelers, 5 Dark Iron Saboteurs and 5 Dark Iron Demolitionists.

quests.name: Carnage
quests.text: Bring Carnage's Head to Rethiel the Greenwarden in The Green Belt.

quests.name: Death to the Dragonmaw
quests.text: Kill 8 Dragonmaw Reclaimers, 5 Dragonmaw Soulbinders, and 3 Dragonmaw Infiltrators in Dragonmaw Retreat for Howin Kindfeather.

quests.name: Forced Disarmament
quests.text: Collect 30 Dragonmaw Armaments in Dragonmaw Retreat, then bring them to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep.

quests.name: MacKreel's Moonshine
quests.text: Take MacKreel's Moonshine to Brewmeister Bilger in Southshore.

quests.name: Fiora Longears
quests.text: Speak with Fiora Longears on the docks at Theramore in Dustwallow Marsh.

quests.name: Nek'rosh's Gambit
quests.text: Destroy the Dragonmaw catapults.

quests.name: Understanding Our Present
quests.text: Use the Goaz Stone near the Goaz Warder and bring its Titanic Keystone back to Prospector Whelgar.

quests.name: Old Habits
quests.text: Bring the Tattered Spellbook to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Harbor.

quests.name: The Thandol Span
quests.text: Rhag Garmason wants you to locate Ol' Rustlocke.

quests.name: The Thandol Span
quests.text: Report back to Rhag Garmason and show him the parchment you found on Rustlocke's corpse.

quests.name: The Thandol Span
quests.text: Destroy the cache of explosives.

quests.name: Plea To The Alliance
quests.text: Seek out Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.

quests.name: Defeat Nek'rosh
quests.text: Kill Chieftain Nek'rosh  Bring Nek'rosh's Head to Captain Stoutfist.

quests.name: Gleaning Our Future
quests.text: Use the Goaz Stone near Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru and bring their hearts back to Prospector Whelgar.

quests.name: Spark of Freedom
quests.text: Escort the captive fire elemental out of Dun Modr and to its freedom.

quests.name: Bring Back a Bang
quests.text: Retrieve 3 Stolen Explosives from the Dark Iron Dwarf camps.

quests.name: Hearts of the Lost
quests.text: Search for Corma's partner Essene.

quests.name: Accessories of the Lost
quests.text: Bring back Essene's Necklace, Essene's Spellbook, and Essene's Waterskin.

quests.name: Sentiments of the Lost
quests.text: Bring Essene's note back to Corma Villard.

quests.name: Stopping the Cycle
quests.text: Kill the Subdued Dragonspawn at the Dragonmaw Gates for Howin Kindfeather.

quests.name: A Grim Task
quests.text: Kill Balgaras the Foul and bring his ear to Longbraid the Grim outside of Dun Modr.

quests.name: James Hyal
quests.text: Speak with Clerk Lendry at Foothold Citadel in Theramore.

quests.text: Inspect the riding horses to choose your first mount.
